recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Questions about references from other resources or newer ImagingSelection refinements should remain with their own Jira issues rather than being folded into FHIR-17183.
issue_request: FHIR-17183 was a Published Imaging Integration change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, to create a resource for referencing selected DICOM study/series/instance/frame content and retrieval endpoints. Although the original proposal used the provisional name ImagingReference, the final resolution points to the linked ImagingSelection Confluence proposal approved by FMG.
initial_application: The issue was implemented by the November 2021 ImagingSelection work: f141f3aacd added the initial resource and fhir.ini wiring with the FHIR-17183 key, cf1ff8eaa6 applied follow-up draft fixes, and df9626b257 merged PR #1502. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key audit for FHIR-17183 existed on the combined branch before this worker.
additional_context: Jira comments and FMG minutes show the resource was renamed from ImagingReference to ImagingSelection, and Jira explicitly notes that adding references from other resources was to be handled by separate tracker items. Current fhir.ini marks ImagingSelection as an active II-owned core resource, and later ImagingSelection tracker work has refined the resource beyond the original draft.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. Current source includes ImagingSelection as a built resource with the canonical StructureDefinition, module/resource-list wiring, DICOM UID elements, instance/frame support, Endpoint references, and ImagingStudy-derived relationship required by the final seed decision.
